title: Ordinary Frobenius exchange followed by point transport is pullback
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and the finite coefficient ring $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, with $\ell\ne p$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite and $n\geq1$, of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Let $Y_0$ be proper of finite type over $k_0$, put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and write $a_Y:Y\to s$. Put $\gamma=(z\mapsto z^q)^{-1}$, $g_Y=\operatorname{id}_{Y_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ and $h=\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]. For each $m\geq1$ the relation $a_Yg_Y^m=h^ma_Y$ specifies the Frobenius Cartesian square [lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian]. Use derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image] at $A$. For $M\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ let
$$
e_{m,M}:L(h^m)^*Ra_{Y*}M\longrightarrow Ra_{Y*}L(g_Y^m)^*M
$$
be the direct-image exchange mate of [def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange], with the Frobenius automorphisms replaced by their $m$-th powers, and let $\iota^{(m)}$ be the restriction--colimit-insertion--derived-pullback point transport [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport] along $h^m$. Use the point fiber [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] and $R\Gamma(Y,-)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{Y*}(-))$ [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology]. Let $\rho_{g_Y^m,M}:R\Gamma(Y,M)\to R\Gamma(Y,L(g_Y^m)^*M)$ be ordinary pullback induced by its adjunction unit and the canonical constant-sheaf identification. Then
$$
\operatorname{Fib}_s(e_{m,M})\circ\iota^{(m)}_{Ra_{Y*}M}=\rho_{g_Y^m,M}
$$
in $D(A)$, naturally in $M$. In particular this uses the semilinear base map $h^m$, without assuming that $g_Y^m$ is a $k$-morphism.
